title: Book Two · Chapter 95: One Line in Front of the Class
story:
The next week, Miss Wu gives the class a notice. Each child will read one line. Then they will explain it. The notice is about a class visit to the school book room. It gives the time, the place and the things to bring.

Ronan reads the line again at his desk. Bring your own pencil. The words are easy for him. He wants a harder line, perhaps the one with two times in it.

Leo gets the line about the return time. Jun gets the place. Mei gets the part about a bag for each pair of books.

Ronan raises his hand.

“Can I have a longer one?”

Miss Wu looks at the notice. “Explain this one first.”

He looks down at his short line. It seems too small a task. He wants everyone to see him read something harder.

When his turn comes, he walks to the front. He reads the line clearly. Then he explains it. Each child needs a pencil from home or their school bag. The book room will not give everyone a new one.

A child asks about a broken pencil. Ronan starts to answer that they can borrow one. Then he stops. The notice does not say that.

“Ask before we go,” he says. He looks at Miss Wu.

She nods. “We can check our pencil points that morning,” she says. Anyone with a problem can tell her then.

Ronan returns to his desk. His answer is useful. But Leo's answer takes more time. Leo explains the two times and points to each one. Several children ask questions.

Ronan watches. He knows the difference between the times too. He wants Miss Wu to ask him next. She gives the next line to someone else.

Later, on the way to the gate, Jun asks to borrow Ronan's sharpener. Ronan takes it out. Jun turns his pencil twice and gives the sharpener back.

“Ready for the visit,” Jun says.

Ronan smiles. “Your own pencil.”

At home, he checks his pencil case. The small wooden bead taps against the side. He takes out two pencils and chooses the stronger one for the visit.

Dad asks about the notice at supper. Ronan tells him his line first. Then he explains Leo's two times from memory and checks them against his paper.

Dad nods at the right time. Ronan feels pleased. He understands his own line and Leo's lines too. Tomorrow, he still has to bring his own pencil.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

line＝一行；point＝指向；explain＝解释。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样准备清楚解释那一行？
2. 他仍然在意什么？

## 读句子

**Ronan / reads / the line again at his desk.** Ronan／在课桌前／再次读那一行。
